digest.component_or_area: ticket store migration / epoch-enforced reclaim window
propositions: Execute a one-time atomic force-with-lease rewrite to reclaim ~92% of the tickets branch history, guarded by operator-confirmed writer quiescence, descendant CI ancestry proof, and live epoch-mismatch refusal from both the deployed review-bot and the explicitly refreshed host binary.

Publish the rewrite only after all real-time writers are quiesced (zero active sessions, all rebar-mcp servers stopped, review-bot /health in_flight==0), no open patchsets lacking LLM-Review votes, and GitHub workflows disabled to block self-redispatch.

Prove non-resurrection post-publish by asserting the old tip is not an ancestor of origin/tickets, verifying the old object is absent from a default clone, and confirming size-pack growth is below 1 MB after the first deterministic review-bot write.

Land the identity.enforce_since re-pin through Gerrit using the commit-map, enabling epoch-mismatch rejection of stale writers without CI deadlock because require_authenticated=false causes verify_authorship to skip the enforce_since check.

Validate the rewrite's correctness by running rebar verify-identity pre/post with identical stderr counts and byte-identical (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) multisets, ensuring no ticket events were altered despite commit SHA rewriting.
